steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: "Beautiful Female Artist," "Witching Hour Adventure Live"...
Lisa peels off the ads disgustedly. Her power turns into butterflies, and she crushes the pieces of paper.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Such distasteful ads under Belphegor Art Museum. I haven't been back in Eastside for months, and it's still as irritating as ever.

Lisa looks around with dissatisfaction at the staff tunnel. It's cold, boring, artificial, devoid of artistic ambiance, and has a high M-value... She would have preferred to enter through the main entrance if not to avoid the noisy brats.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: I see you've stopped in your tracks. Have you encountered any trouble during the exhibition?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: It's not more of a hassle than wasting precious time to deal with Mania instead of enjoying the exhibition, but... I noticed that trouble has been following me...
Special lights gather and fly toward the back of a concrete pillar.
Please don't do this, Miss Lisa.
Someone dashes out from behind the pillar, nimbly avoiding the attack.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: You know me?

Hahaha, the once-famous painter who had her right hand injured in an accident and became Eastside's sharpest art critic. I've heard your name in other strange stories, but you rarely show up. It's an honor to meet you here.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I'm also honored to have run into someone as suspicious as you in this stinky underground parking lot.
Hahaha, you've really got a personality like the rumors say, Miss Lisa.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: What? You were hiding behind a pillar, sneaking around and eavesdropping. Should I have invited you to come out politely?

Please excuse my rudeness, Miss Lisa. It's just that seeing how familiar you are with this place, I was impressed by your charms of personality, your confidence. I got intrigued and forgot to introduce myself...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Stop it! I have urgent business to attend to and don't have time for your hypocritical nonsense.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: So, why are you following me in the underground parking lot instead of viewing the exhibition upstairs?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: You are holding the pair of antique letter openers sold at an amazing price in Eastside a few years ago, and your shirt is silk taffeta. Your glasses, brooch, and belt are all worth a lot...
Lisa eyes the person up and down with some disdain.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Don't tell me you're here to show off your luxury items to the concrete pillars.
You see right through me, Miss Lisa. In that case, I won't beat around the bush with you.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: I'm <color=#fb9259>McQueen</color>, an art agent who got lost in Witching Hour. I would like to make a deal with you, Miss Lisa.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Take me out of here, Miss Lisa, and I'll help you deal with them...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Them?
Before Lisa finishes her sentence, a dark shadow springs out from behind the suspicious woman claiming to be an agent and lunges at them with a scream...
